team.name: flaxos
team.notes: Keen to keep things grounded, dial chevrons under fire, and ensure we actually ship a playable Stargate co-op prototype!

team.name: Scotty
team.notes: Ready to pair on netcode, Jaffa AI, P90 recoil, and transport ring drops.

questions.title: What camera angle & perspective should dictate our tactical gameplay?
questions.subtitle: The camera dictates 80% of asset and animation workload. A smart choice guarantees we actually finish.

options.title: Isometric / Top-Down 3D Tactical (Helldivers 1, Alien Swarm, Synthetik)
options.description: Full squad tactical awareness. Clear Jaffa patrol vision cones, coordinated crossfires, transport ring drop telegraphs, and C4 ambush lines. Zero first-person viewmodel or complex weapon animation traps.
pros: Perfect for stealth cones & tactical traps
Great fit for low-poly Synty assets
options.caution: Less cinematic face-to-face NPC immersion, but mechanically 10/10.

options.title: Third-Person Over-the-Shoulder (Helldivers 2, Ghost Recon Wildlands)
options.description: Cinematic combat perspective behind the marine's shoulder. Thrilling when dialing the DHD or watching Death Glider strafe runs, but requires cover rigging and camera collision math.
options.caution: 3D camera obstacle collisions and aim-IK animations add substantial scope.

options.title: First-Person Tactical (GTFO, Payday 2, Six Days in Fallujah)
options.description: Total claustrophobic immersion. Stepping through the Stargate puddle in first-person, checking P90 magazine counts, and holding flashlight beams down dark pyramid corridors.
pros: Maximum immersion and horror tension during night raids
options.caution: Requires detailed viewmodel rigs, iron-sight aiming, and reload animation states.

options.title: Hybrid SGC Hub (1st Person SGC Gate Room + Top-Down Planetary Raids)
options.description: Walk around the Cheyenne Mountain Gate Room and armory in 1st person; step through the Stargate event horizon and transition seamlessly into top-down tactical squad action.
pros: Best of both worlds: iconic SGC briefing feel + crisp tactical raid gameplay
options.caution: Two camera rigs to support, though hub can be lightweight.

comments.text: Isometric / Top-Down 3D lets us build stealth vision cones, C4 traps, and transport rings 5x faster without getting bogged down in animation blending!

questions.title: How should our 'Stealth-to-Loud' extraction loop play out?
questions.subtitle: A 4-person SG team is always wildly outnumbered by Jaffa battalions. Starting quiet and extracting loud is the signature SG-1 rhythm.

options.title: Full Recon -> C4 Sabotage -> Transport Ring Alarm -> DHD Dial Under Fire
options.description: Insert through gate. Scout with MALP/Zats quietly. Plant C4 on the primary objective. Once detonated (or cover blown), orbital Ha'tak rings drop Jaffa shock-troops. Squad fights back to DHD, punches 7 chevrons under fire, transmits IDC code to open SGC iris, and dives through!
pros: Natural escalation from tension to chaotic action
options.caution: DHD dial timer must be balanced so it's clutch, not frustrating.

options.title: Aggressive Strike & Bunker Buster (Fast Pace)
options.description: Loud from the drop. Call in SGC artillery or drone strikes, breach fortified Jaffa gates with shape charges, secure alien artifact, and establish a defensive perimeter at the gate.
options.caution: Loses some of that tense SG-1 covert recon flavor.

options.title: Dynamic Alert Heat Level (Metal Gear × Helldivers)
options.description: Patrols stay suspicious if bodies are found. If alarm consoles are activated, Jaffa patrols call in Death Glider fly-bys and transport ring heavy reinforcements.
pros: Rewards careful silenced play and hiding bodies with Zat 2-shot disintegration
options.caution: Requires alarm radio AI state.

questions.title: Which mission archetypes should we support in our core framework?
questions.subtitle: By reusing the same gate, ring, and AI prefabs, we can build multiple game modes with zero extra engine overhead. (Multi-select)

options.title: Goa'uld Outpost Sabotage & Extraction
options.description: Infiltrate a planetary fortress, plant C4 on a Naquadah power core or Tel'tak cargo ship, trigger a distraction, and fight back to the Stargate.
pros: Great mix of stealth and loud gunplay
options.caution: Needs clear primary and secondary objectives.

options.title: SGC Gate Room Foothold / Iris Defense (Horde Mode)
options.description: A foothold situation in Cheyenne Mountain! The Iris is breached. Defend the Gate Room from waves of incoming Jaffa, seal blast doors, set up Browning .50 cals, and hold until techs force-dial out.
pros: Self-contained room defense (very fast to build)
options.caution: Keep wave pacing tight so players don't run dry on ammo.

options.title: Alpha Site / Village Evacuation Defense
options.description: Protect a human settlement or off-world Alpha Site from swarms of Jaffa landing via transport rings while civilians escape through the dialed Stargate.
options.caution: Civilian escort pathfinding must not be annoying.

options.title: Ha'tak Mothership Infiltration (via Transport Rings)
options.description: Locate hidden transport rings on a planet surface, beam up into an orbiting Goa'uld Ha'tak, plant C4 on the hyperdrive crystal room, and ring back down before detonation.
options.caution: Requires interior mothership tile set.

comments.text: Starting with Outpost Sabotage + Iris Defense gives us both an extraction mode AND an awesome wave mode using the exact same weapons and Jaffa AI!

questions.title: Which SGC soldier archetypes should our squad select from?
questions.subtitle: Asymmetric roles make 2-4 player co-op feel like a genuine SG team rather than 4 clones. (Multi-select)

options.title: Pointman / Recon Leader (The O'Neill / Mitchell)
options.description: Suppressed P90, tactical C4 satchel, flashbangs, sprint dodge. Can tag enemies through walls and set remote detonators.
options.caution: Moderate armor.

options.title: Tech Specialist & Archaeologist (The Carter / Daniel)
options.description: Armed with MP5. Fast DHD chevron dialer (cuts dial time in half), carries GDO transmitter for Iris override, deploys MALP/UAV scout drones, hacks Ancient terminals.
options.caution: Lighter combat firepower.

options.title: Heavy Support Marine (SG-3 Marine)
options.description: M249 SAW light machine gun, claymore anti-personnel mines, deployable Browning .50 cal tripod, shoulder-fired rocket launcher for turret busting.
pros: Carries the squad during loud phase
options.caution: Slower sprint speed, noisy weapons.

options.title: Allied Jaffa / Tok'ra Infiltrator (The Teal'c / Bra'tac)
options.description: Ma'Tok Staff weapon (heavy plasma blasts and melee parry), Zat'nik'tel (silent 1-shot stun / 2-shot kill), healing ribbon device, symbiote regeneration.
options.caution: Needs distinctive staff weapon firing sounds and particle FX.

questions.title: Which signature Stargate mechanics will make the game legendary?
questions.subtitle: Unique mechanics that you can only get in a Stargate co-op game. (Multi-select)

options.title: The 7-Chevron DHD Dialing Mini-Game Under Fire
options.description: Dialing isn't a simple button press! One player must punch the 7 glyph chevrons on the DHD (or hold a sequence like a Helldivers Stratagem) while teammates form a defensive firing arc. Transmit the IDC code before diving into the event horizon!
pros: Every extraction is a story you talk about
options.caution: Ensure controls feel crisp on both keyboard and gamepad.

options.title: Authentic Zat'nik'tel Rules (1-Shot Stun, 2-Shot Kill/Disintegrate)
options.description: 1st shot silently incapacitates Jaffa guards for 20 seconds. 2nd shot kills and vaporizes the body completely, preventing patrols from discovering corpses and triggering alarms!
pros: Deep stealth utility (vaporizing bodies without carrying them)
options.caution: Zat ammo/charge should be limited to prevent trivializing encounters.

options.title: Transport Rings (Enemy Spawns & Tactical Flanking)
options.description: Five glowing metallic rings slam down with iconic audio. Enemies arrive in drop waves, but clever players can throw grenades into descending rings or step inside to teleport across the compound.
pros: Dynamic 3D entry without awkward elevator shafts
options.caution: Teleport collision checking must be clean.

options.title: Remote C4 & Beacon Distractions
options.description: Plant C4 on a fuel depot on a far ridge. Trigger detonation to pull Jaffa patrols away from the central temple entrance, opening a silent infiltration window.
options.caution: AI sensory radius must react reliably to explosion sounds.

options.title: MALP / UAV Scout Drone Recon
options.description: Pilot a wheeled MALP probe or miniature UAV drone through the Stargate first to map out Jaffa sentries, alarm horns, and Naquadah deposits on the squad's HUD.
options.caution: Drone piloting controls should be streamlined.

comments.text: The DHD 7-chevron dial under fire and the 2-shot Zat body vaporize mechanic are absolute must-haves!

questions.title: Which game engine and asset pipeline will we use?
questions.subtitle: We need an engine that handles 3D lighting, clean Git merges with Scotty, and easy integration of military/sci-fi low-poly asset packs.

options.title: Godot 4.x (GDScript) + Low-Poly Asset Packs (Synty FBX/glTF)
options.description: Ultra-lightweight, blazing fast compile times, text-based .tscn scene files that Git merges cleanly without merge conflict hell. Godot 4's Forward+ renderer gives us gorgeous glowing Stargate kawoosh shaders, Zat lightning arcs, and volumetric ring beams out of the box.
pros: Clean Git collaboration for pair dev
Fastest agentic code gen with Claude/Codex
options.caution: Requires importing FBX/glTF models into Godot materials.

options.title: Unity 6 (C#) + Synty POLYGON Military & Sci-Fi
options.description: Massive pre-built asset ecosystem. Plug-and-play character controllers, pre-rigged military animations, sound packs, and particle systems available directly on the Unity Asset Store.
options.caution: Binary scene files and meta files can cause Git friction between team members.

options.title: Web-Native 3D (Three.js / Babylon.js + Vite)
options.description: Zero installation for anyone. Send a URL link in Discord, click it, and you're stepping through the Stargate in Chrome/Edge.
options.caution: More boilerplate for 3D physics and character animation controllers.

questions.title: What visual direction & art style will look stellar and be fast to build?
questions.subtitle: Visual budget should focus on iconic Stargate shaders and lighting rather than high-poly texture baking.

options.title: Stylized Low-Poly 3D + Next-Gen Dynamic Lighting (Synty × Deep Rock Galactic)
options.description: Clean geometric character silhouettes, sandy Abydos desert temples, dark Goa'uld pyramid interiors, with high-end dynamic point lights, glowing staff weapon plasma bolts, and fluid Stargate water shaders.
options.caution: Must maintain consistent color grading across levels.

options.title: Retro 90s Tactical Stealth / PS1 Crunch (Metal Gear Solid × SG-1)
options.description: Low-res textured meshes, scanlines, gritty military CRT monitors, dithering, and retro sound effects matching the 1997 television era.
options.caution: Niche aesthetic.

options.title: Realistic Tactical PBR (Military Sim)
options.description: Photorealistic P90s, camouflage fatigues, detailed normal maps, and realistic bullet physics.
options.caution: Massive asset pipeline bottleneck that risks abandoning the project.

questions.title: What is our hard target for Milestone 1 (First Playable Netcode Prototype)?
questions.subtitle: To defeat the curse of unfinished game dev, we must lock in a realistic first playable milestone.

options.title: The 2-Week SGC Vertical Slice (Recommended)
options.description: 14 days to a playable co-op raid: 1 Gate Room, 1 desert outpost arena, 2 character classes (P90 & Staff weapon), basic Jaffa patrol AI, C4 explosion, DHD dialing, and successful extraction through the puddle.
pros: Sweet spot for agentic pair programming
Guarantees a playable Friday night session
options.caution: Requires strict commitment to cut non-essential features.

options.title: The 48-Hour Weekend Graybox Jam
options.description: Hyper-focused 2-day sprint. Graybox geometry, 2 player capsules moving together, stepping through a blue portal, shooting dummy targets, and dialing back home.
options.caution: Intense weekend push.

options.title: The 1-Month SGC Expedition Build
options.description: 4 weekly sprints: Week 1 Gate & Netcode, Week 2 P90 & Staff combat feel, Week 3 Jaffa AI & C4 sabotage, Week 4 DHD extraction & SGC Gate Room polish.
pros: More breathing room for audio and polished VFX
options.caution: Must maintain momentum every Friday.

questions.title: How should we divide the core development pillars?
questions.subtitle: Clear domain ownership prevents bystander effect while working with AI coding agents. (Multi-select)

options.title: Stargate & Multiplayer Netcode Czar
options.description: Owns room connections, player position synchronization, DHD chevron state sync, and Stargate event horizon portal transitions.
options.caution: High responsibility for network stability.

options.title: Tactical Combat & Juice Lead (P90, Staff Weapon, Zat, C4)
options.description: Tunes weapon recoil, sound effects, screen shake, staff blast impacts, Zat stun arcs, and C4 detonation physics.
pros: Directly creates the punchy Stargate feel
options.caution: Needs regular playtesting tweaks.

options.title: AI Agent Orchestrator & Prompt Architect
options.description: Owns the system prompts, architectural rules, agent dev loop (Codex/Antigravity/Claude Code), and keeping code structure clean.
pros: Ensures coding agents produce modular, maintainable code
options.caution: Maintains code reviews and documentation.

options.title: Jaffa Enemy AI & Stealth Scripter
options.description: Scripts patrol paths, vision cones, hearing radius for unsilenced gunshots, alarm sounding, and transport ring drop waves.
pros: Brings tension and life to the encounters
options.caution: Keep AI state machine clean and predictable.

options.title: Stargate Shaders, Level Design & Sound Czar
options.description: Creates the blue puddle kawoosh shader, transport ring light beams, DHD dialing soundscape, and Egyptian-alien temple props.
pros: Delivers the authentic Stargate nostalgia and atmosphere
options.caution: Focus on shaders and audio before bespoke modeling.

comments.text: I can lead the AI agent tooling and pair with Scotty on netcode, P90 recoil, and Stargate portal shaders!
